text: In Pest **4**, the primary change affecting snapshot tests is an alteration in how **snapshot names are generated** when using the `toMatchSnapshot` expectation [–k4SUV]. This modification has a **High** likelihood of impact, requiring users to update their existing snapshots after upgrading [–k4SUV]. To do this, users must run the command `./vendor/bin/pest --update-snapshots`, which rebuilds the snapshot files to conform to the new naming convention [–k4SUV]. While Pest **4** also upgraded its PHP requirement to **8.3.0** or greater and is built on **PHPUnit 12**, these are broader system changes, whereas the snapshot name generation directly impacts the behavior and maintenance of snapshot tests themselves [–k4SUV][1].
